How to Apply

Official Step-by-Step Application Guide, Document Submissions & Bank Challan Payments at University of Loralai

Admission Session Fall 2026

Step-by-Step Admission Application Guide

Follow our official 6-phase application roadmap to register online, deposit the ABL bank challan, assemble your document dossier, and submit your application to the University of Loralai Admissions Office.

Access Online Admission PortalDownload Admission Form (PDF)Generate ABL Fee Challan
Application Roadmap

6 Phases from Application to Final Enrollment

Clear, transparent instructions to ensure your application dossier is processed accurately.

01
Phase 1

Select Program & Check Eligibility

Review the minimum academic percentage and prerequisite requirements for your intended department.

Step 1 of 6
02
Phase 2

Online Portal Registration

Create an account on the UOLI Online Admission Portal and fill in personal & academic details.

Step 2 of 6
03
Phase 3

Deposit Fee Challan at ABL Bank

Generate the ABL fee deposit challan (Rs. 2,000 for BS/DPT/B.Ed, Rs. 3,000 for MS/PhD) and pay at any Allied Bank branch.

Step 3 of 6
04
Phase 4

Assemble Document Dossier

Print the completed online application form and attach attested copies of SSC, HSSC, DMC, CNIC, Local Domicile, Photos, and original ABL challan receipt.

Step 4 of 6
05
Phase 5

Mail Hardcopy to Admission Office

Submit or mail the hardcopy application packet to the Admissions Office, University of Loralai, Zerh Karez, Quetta Road, Loralai before deadline.

Step 5 of 6
06
Phase 6

Entry Test & Merit Verification

Appear for the departmental entry test / interview on the scheduled date and check the merit list publication on the portal.

Step 6 of 6

Physical Dossier Submission

Mandatory Supporting Documents

Attach attested photocopies of all the following certificates and documents along with your printed online application form before mailing to the university:

Secondary School Certificate (Matric / SSC)

Attested copy of Matriculation Certificate & DMC issued by a recognized BISE board.

Required Attachment
Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate)

Attested copy of Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / ICS / I.Com) Certificate & provisional certificate.

Required Attachment
Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC)

Attested copy of official Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC) of Intermediate showing marks breakdown.

Required Attachment
Applicant CNIC / Smart Card / B-Form

Attested copy of Computerized National Identity Card or Form-B for candidates under 18 years.

Required Attachment
Local / Domicile Certificate

Attested copy of District Local / Domicile certificate of Balochistan.

Required Attachment
Character Certificate

Attested character certificate issued by the principal/head of the last attended institution.

Required Attachment
Recent Passport-Size Photographs

6 recent passport-size photographs with blue background (applicant name written on back).

Required Attachment
Father / Guardian CNIC

Attested copy of Computerized National Identity Card of father or legal guardian.

Required Attachment
Migration Certificate

Original Migration Certificate (required for candidates from educational boards outside Balochistan / Quetta BISE).

Required Attachment
IBCC Equivalence Certificate

Equivalence certificate from Inter Board Committee of Chairmen (IBCC) for A-Levels, Sanvia-Khasa, or foreign credentials.

Required Attachment
Printed University Admission Form

Completed, printed, and signed copy of the online application form from the UOLi admission portal.

Required Attachment
Original Bank Processing Fee Challan (ABL)

Original paid ABL bank challan receipt of application processing fee (Rs. 2,000 for BS/DPT/Allied/B.Ed, Rs. 3,000 for MS/PhD).

Required Attachment
Hardcopy Dispatch Postal Address
